verdict.rationale: Bento is a trace-capture and observability platform, so controlling how long trace data is kept and deleting it is a fair question to ask. The pack never documents retention settings, deletion APIs, or purge controls. The '30 days' mention is a default query window for reading signal firings, not a retention policy, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
